scope: Base system only; all native hardware, Wi-Fi/SSH and original M5 launcher retained; no device access, image build or app optimization in this review.
conclusion: Retain the two evidence-backed activity candidates, strengthen battery-powered promotion and realistic duty-cycle gates, and add bounded qualification improvements without new default BSP tuning.

findings.suggestion: Require validated unplugged battery energy or controlled usable-runtime benefit for promotion; USB input is screening only.
findings.basis: Published separate USB/battery supply paths and existing gauge limitations; experimental design, not measured benefit.

findings.suggestion: Equal elapsed idle windows, equal completed burst work plus common return-to-idle cycle, same useful runtime endpoints and unchanged shutdown safeguards; predeclare usage weights and per-condition regression limits.
findings.basis: A lower energy total over shorter or less useful work is not a comparable outcome.

findings.suggestion: Capture/preserve leaf autosuspend delay2000ms plus wakeup attribute and residency; conditionally compare5000ms only if measured resume churn erases benefit.
findings.basis: Existing raw leaf delay2000ms; runtime PM transitions consume time and energy.

findings.suggestion: Factor1 is first candidate, not predetermined optimum; bounded factors2/5 only if battery energy/performance question remains; retain other controls.
findings.basis: Earlier trials establish clock residency, not net battery energy or latency.

findings.suggestion: Serialize supported preset/update/apply paths, invalidate generations/remove stale owned overrides, verify effective state and restore only validated controls or perform controlled baseline boot.
findings.basis: Deleting a file does not stop an already-open concurrent reader.

findings.suggestion: Check physical IMX219/CSI/V3D/HDMI/USB return to appropriate idle after legitimate resource release; no forced suspension under required clients.
findings.basis: These camera/graphics devices already reported runtime-suspended in earlier passive evidence; clock rate alone is not PM/energy proof.

findings.suggestion: Preserve effective Wi-Fi PS across provisioning/newprofiles/reconnect/roam/restart, respecting explicit user choices; test locked NM version.
findings.basis: Observed profile default0 delegates rather than proving ON; live effective state was ON.

findings.suggestion: Keep APT/security schedule initially; classify actual activations; any nonurgent deferral needs finite perjob deadline/retry/manual/freshness fallback; unknown power signal cannot justify security deferral.
findings.basis: ConditionACPower passes if AC connectors unknown; persistent calendar triggers do not guarantee retry/completion.

findings.suggestion: Include screenon/off, intermittent SSH, legitimate Ethernet/USB, boot/apply/reapply/shutdown/off, lostAP and longer sessions with actual maintenance.
findings.basis: Short settled counter samples do not expose duty-cycle costs.

findings.suggestion: Record topology/instrument burden, avoid charging/back-power/USB wake from logger, match buffered cadence and profile outside energy windows.
findings.basis: Observer activity can invalidate the measured PM state and battery-only supply.

findings.suggestion: Test planned combination after isolated hardware/performance passes even if standalone energy is inconclusive; require combined proof.
findings.basis: Policy interactions can be measurable without resolving both isolated energy effects.

findings.suggestion: Distinguish added-policy savings versus Zero baseline from whole-image savings versus matched full-source; baseline alone can fulfill image objective if battery benefit is demonstrated.
findings.basis: Desktop/base-stack changes may contribute independently of additional power policy.

findings.suggestion: Record one-time provisioning and deliberate setup reboot separately from ordinary configured cold-boot energy.
findings.basis: A configured candidate and unconfigured control are not comparable session states.

sources.version_scope: Current upstream documentation explains semantics; version-locked package/live evidence and real Zero qualification remain authoritative.

resolved_findings: Battery-powered benefit is required for extra-policy promotion; USB input is screening only.
Idle energy, useful work cycles and runtime endpoints are compared on equivalent terms, with declared per-condition limits and observer controls.
Combined testing follows isolated hardware/performance passes even if standalone energy is inconclusive.
Candidate-versus-Zero-baseline and whole-image-versus-full-source battery claims have separate references; baseline can meet the image objective if its comparison passes.
One-time provisioning energy is separate from ordinary configured boot energy.
Initial leaf delay is captured as2000ms; bounded intermediate factors2/5 and delay5000ms are conditional, not new defaults.
Post-activation invalidation serializes supported paths and verifies live baseline recovery; stale file removal alone is insufficient.
Hardware idle return is consumer-aware; effective WiFi PS and security-safe maintenance are qualified without disabling hardware or adding a pollingdaemon.
